verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Aider can run against local models via Ollama or any local OpenAI-compatible API (aider-docs-8, aider-docs-35). That keeps code on the user's machine, so it cannot be used for third-party training. This is an indirect workaround that depends on the user's model choice, not a documented privacy control. missing for 10: an explicit data-use/no-training policy, documentation of what data is sent to hosted LLM providers, telemetry/analytics opt-out controls, guidance on provider training opt-outs, and independent corroboration.
